title: calanthe alpina var. fimbriata
intro: Calanthe alpina var. fimbriata, commonly known as the Fimbriated Calanthe, is a type of flowering orchid native to the Himalayas. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which are said to have various health benefits such as reducing fever and inflammation, as well as acting as a tonic to improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Calanthe alpina var. fimbriata include its ability to relieve respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
